notes:
Run 2026-10-25 23:40 UTC to 2026-10-26 01:07 UTC (date field is the task day, 2026-10-25) on a 4-vCPU / 15.6 GB shared cloud VM, so absolute timings are noisy; ratios are the useful signal. grit = main at the commit above (release build, grit 0.5.20, rustc 1.99.0); git = system git 2.43.0; no baseline release measured. No repo code was touched; unmodified grit, grit-bench and grit-http-server release binaries from main were used.
Harness: `grit-bench daily` aborts the whole run when any scenario fails (a one-shot full run died at add/hunks@large-file after about 15 minutes of fixture building), so it was run once per scenario (`--only <id>`, 146 executable ids; grit-http-server was built afterwards and the four HTTP scenarios clone/http, clone/shallow-depth1-http, fetch/incremental-http and push/incremental-http were run with --http-server). Per-scenario JSON was merged and converted to this schema (median_wall_ms -> median_ms, peak_rss_bytes -> max_rss_kb); headline=true/name are as flagged by grit-bench (the 17 required headline scenarios plus log/json-100, pull/rebase, push/force-with-lease, branch/list-json and branch/merged). `detail` objects (commands, prepare, correctness, phases) are carried unchanged. runs is 3 to 20 timed runs per tool after warmup (harness policy). The harness isolates git/grit config itself (empty GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM, fixed identity) even though this VM's global git config has core.fsmonitor, commit.gpgsign and URL rewrites; a spot check of 5 headline scenarios under an explicit external GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL gave ratios within 7% of the first pass. The repos block is carried over from the 2026-10-24 report; the cached fixtures were re-counted (files, commits and refs match, object dirs within a few MB).
Noise re-runs: compared with daily/latest.json of 2026-10-24 (grit/git time ratio more than 20% worse, or peak-RSS ratio more than 30% worse), 20 scenarios were re-run 3 more times (4 invocations per tool; reported median_ms and max_rss_kb are the median of the four per-invocation medians/peaks, runs/samples_ms/min/max/stddev are over all samples; per-row `rerun` records the invocation count and the first-pass grit/git ratio): add/dry-run@synth-10k, branch/merged-ref@many-refs, cat/blob@git-git, clone/checkout@synth-100k, config/get@small, config/set@small, diff/worktree@synth-10k, ignore/check-1000@synth-10k, log/author@git-git, merge/clean@synth-100k, merge/clean@synth-10k, notes/list@synth-10k, pick/one@synth-100k, pick/one@synth-10k, remote/list@small, revert/one@synth-10k, revs/author-n50@deep-history, revs/left-right-count@deep-history, worktree/add@synth-10k, worktree/list@synth-10k. Outcome: 15 of 20 still exceed the threshold after the re-runs (real changes against yesterday, most only a 0.2x to 0.5x shift on millisecond-scale commands); add/dry-run@synth-10k, diff/worktree@synth-10k, merge/clean@synth-100k, revs/left-right-count@deep-history, worktree/list@synth-10k fell back under the threshold.
Failures (kept with grit=null and an error; neither tool has a number, all are harness failures, the same 7 as yesterday, nothing was substituted): add/hunks@large-file, add/patch-file@large-file and revs/count-path@git-git (the git side of the timed run exits 128), add/lines@large-file and remote/rename@many-refs (scenario prepare command exits 1 before any timing), clone/shallow@git-git (correctness check cannot find its `remote.git-campaign-clone` directory for `git fsck`; also failed on a second attempt), push/refspec@git-git (grit push rejected as non-fast-forward in the harness correctness check).
Largest gaps: log/path@git-git is 6.7x git (2.4 s vs 0.36 s); ignore/check-1000@synth-10k 3.8x time and 2.5x memory; log/stat-n50@git-git 3.4x time and 3.0x memory; revs/count-author@deep-history 3.2x time and 3.0x memory; branch/rename@many-refs 3.2x; commit/dry-run@synth-10k 2.4x; diff/worktree@deep-tree 2.3x. Peak memory is about 2x git on most small worktree commands (status, diff, add, switch; pick/revert 2.7x). grit is well ahead of git on network scenarios against local remotes: push 0.44x to 0.72x, fetch and pull 0.44x to 0.45x, pull/rebase 0.33x.
